description: Supply-chain verdict for one package, no docs: known advisories (CVE/GHSA, malware), deprecation, license, newest version with no known advisories, the safe version on the same release line as the one you pass, and typosquat lookalikes. For several packages use check-packages, one call for the whole list.

detail.description: Return the full JSON report (every advisory, dates, sources) instead of the summary.

ecosystem.description: npm, pypi, cargo, go, maven, nuget, rubygems or composer (aliases like "python" work).

name.description: Package name as the registry knows it, e.g. "lodash", "requests".

version.description: Version you intend to install or already use.

name: check-package
title: Check a package before installing it
